name: giga-stream
description: Giga Stream: the interface (src/frontend), the fileserver and Electron host (src/fileserver) and the admin backend (src/backend). See docs/00.

scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,electron,live-server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev --prefix src/backend" "npm run dev --prefix src/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix src/fileserver" "npm run live:dev"
scripts.live:dev: npm run fixtures && npm run dev:test-channels --prefix src/live-server
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --prefix src/frontend && npm run build --prefix src/fileserver && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs
